title: Inputs, Outputs & Success Criteria
summary: Structure agent systems, integrate them into the SDLC, define the planning/execution boundary, configure observability, and right-size human oversight.

rows: Issue text, PR diff, file path
Modified files, new PR, test report
What the agent must NOT do
Never modify config/, never push to main
Test pass rate, lint errors, vuln count

blocks.text: **Exam Tip:** When a question says "the team can't tell if the agent is working," the root cause is always missing success criteria and evaluation signals — not a tool or model problem.
